text: The proposal is designed to address climate risks through three interlinked components: climate-proofed smallholder production, post-harvest loss reduction, and capacity building. It is community-centered and focuses on climate-smart agriculture, with a near-$10M funding scale. The proposal has been iteratively refined through technical reviews and aligns with national strategies and Adaptation Fund safeguards.

metadata.solution_name: Adaptation of Small-Scale Agriculture for improved food security of resilient communities in Papua New Guinea
